# Personal filesystem paths that are permitted to appear in tracked files.
#
# This file should stay EMPTY. Real DAW projects embed absolute paths like
# /Users/<someone>/Music/..., and pasting one into a doc publishes a stranger's
# home directory and username. Redact to /Users/<producer-a>/ instead.
#
# Two such paths were allowlisted here during initial authoring and have since
# been redacted. If you find yourself adding an entry, redact the document
# instead — that is almost always the correct fix.
